name: Book Like A Boss
tagline: The visible booking storefront loop is buildable, but a credible replacement needs more than the first screen. Book Like A Boss earns its keep through OAuth, calendar reliability, so expect a weekend or multi-day build and a narrower personal scope.
verdictSummary: KINDA: Book Like A Boss has usage-based pricing. Here is the practical trade-off and what you lose.
